nodes.name: lemma:line_search
nodes.statement:
If we choose the next iterate $\boldsymbol{Y}_k$ as in 33 such that the conditions 34 and 35 are both satisfied,
then we have 
\begin{align*}{\small 
p(\boldsymbol{Y}_{k-1})-p(\boldsymbol{Y}_{k})\geq \delta_{s} \delta_{w}\|p\| \|t_{k-1}\boldsymbol{V}_{k-1}\|
\geq \sigma_{p}\|p\| \|\boldsymbol{Y}_{k}-\boldsymbol{Y}_{k-1}\|,}
\end{align*}
where $\sigma_p=(\delta_{s} \delta_{w})/\mathrm{M}_{e}$.

nodes.name: theorem_main_weak_conv
nodes.statement:
In BCD-GLU, BCD-GQU and BCD-GU algorithms for cost function 3,
if the iterates remain bounded, i.e., the condition 5 is satisfied, 
and $\boldsymbol{\omega}_*$ is an accumulation point of the iterates $\{\boldsymbol{\omega}_{k}\}_{k\ge1}$,
then $\boldsymbol{\omega}_*$ is a stationary point of the cost function 3.
nodes.section: Figure 2: Proof structure of ? for BCD-GLU algorithm.

nodes.name: theorem-weak-general_c
nodes.statement:
In alg:BCD-G-RL for cost function 3, 
if there exists $\eta>0$ such that
\begin{equation}
f(\boldsymbol{\omega}_{k-1})-f(\boldsymbol{\omega}_{k})\geq\eta\|f_{t_k}\|^2
\end{equation}
always holds, then $\lim_{k\rightarrow\infty}f=0$.
In particular, if $\boldsymbol{\omega}_*$ is an accumulation point of the iterates $\{\boldsymbol{\omega}_{k}\}_{k\ge1}$,
then $\boldsymbol{\omega}_*$ is a stationary point of $f$.
